summary.one_liner: Fathom Lite is a self-hosted, open-source website analytics server written in Go, the original Lite version of the hosted Fathom Analytics product, now in maintenance-only mode.
summary.what_it_does: Fathom Lite is the first and open-source version of Fathom Analytics, a privacy-focused website analytics tool. You run it on your own server, create a site in its dashboard, and add the tracking snippet to the websites you want to measure. The README says no new features are being added to this Lite version, but the maintainers will keep fixing bugs long-term. The README includes a comparison table listing features that exist only in the hosted product, such as the API, custom events, ecommerce tracking, EU routing, GA import, email reports, and CSV export. The Lite version uses cookies, has an older dashboard UI, and is described as a typical single-site install. Installation is via a Go and NPM build with a user account created from the command line, or via a Docker image.
use_cases: google analytics alternative on my own server
track visitors on a small website
run analytics in a Docker container
how_to_run: Ensure you have Go and NPM installed
Download the code: git clone the repository into your GOPATH
Compile the project into an executable: make build
Register a user account: ./fathom user add --email= --password=
Start the webserver: ./fathom server, then visit the dashboard
notable: Original open-source version of the hosted Fathom Analytics product
Tracking snippet with a documented Content Security Policy requirement
Maintenance-only: bug fixes continue but no new features are planned
caveats: No new features are being added; only bug fixes and maintenance
Self-hosted: you run the servers, updates, and backups yourself
Uses cookies, unlike the hosted product's cookie-free tracking
